component.name: WhatNull
component.summary: Open source, Linux-first, secure WhatsApp desktop client

description.p: WhatNull is an open source, privacy-first, low-resource WhatsApp desktop client engineered specifically for Linux desktop environments.

ul.li: Privacy Protection: Focus blur overlays and zero telemetry by default
Multi-Account Support: Fully isolated WebKit session partitions
Low Resource Overhead: Lightweight Rust (Tauri v2) backend
Linux First: Native system notifications, system tray, and Wayland support
Navigation Security: External browser routing for non-WhatsApp links

description.p: Initial release of WhatNull featuring secure WebView sandbox, privacy focus blur, and multi-account profile isolation.
